name: Hyosung Corporation
summary: Hyosung Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture of chemical fibers in Korea and internationally. The company operates through textile and trading segments. It engages in the provision of nylon and polyester yarns and fabrics, and dyeing products; spandex products under the creora brand; steel and chemical trade; and material solutions for semiconductor and display technology environments. The company also provides power transmission and distribution grid solutions; industrial infrastructure solutions; renewable energy; plant pumps; and building and general pumps; housing, civil engineering, and architecture services.
